Game Overview

In Mars Invasion, the core idea is straightforward: defend Mars from relentless invaders in this thrilling arcade shooter. Control your spaceship with simple arrow keys while it auto-fires, letting you focus on strategic movement and dodging. Collect power-ups, rack up points, and enjoy fast-paced, addictive gameplay that challenges all ages.
